$comment: The bundle budgets of NFR-PERF-03, held by pnpm check:bundle (scripts/check-bundle.ts) after next build.
Sizes are gzip level 9 bytes of the emitted files, with 1 KB = 1,024 bytes (D-022). The method is D-037 in DECISIONS.md.
firstLoad: the first rule whose pattern matches a route sets its budget. A pattern ending in /** also matches the route itself.

lazy: a budget counts the chunks that import() of its trigger modules fetches, on the route where they weigh most, Web Workers included. A trigger is a path from the project root or a package name. A budget with no triggers is pending until its feature loads lazily. A shared budget's chunks count there only, never again in another budget.
